patch_description:
The current candidate already reaches the parameter-economy floor (n_params=8, one shared "theta" per repetition) and achieves perfect train/val/test accuracy with zero generalization gap. Among prior candidates with the same accuracy/param count, the variant with a longer, denser gate sequence per repetition (depth ~96) converged in only 30 steps versus 60-240 for shallower variants — extra non-commuting rotations/entanglers give the optimizer a smoother, more expressive loss landscape without adding any trainable parameters (still 1 unique name "theta" per repetition).

Following the recommendation, I duplicate the core sequence (RX→RY→alternating CNOT/CZ ring→skip-2 CZ→antipodal CRZ→RZ) once more within the same block, all reusing "theta". This roughly doubles depth/gate count (targeting ~96-108 depth) while keeping n_params fixed at 8, aiming to reduce convergence_step_mean similarly to the fastest-converging prior variant (30 steps) while preserving the perfect accuracy and zero generalization gap already achieved.
